newsitem.title: UK: NWE naphtha trade dull as end-users stay out.
newsitem.headline: NWE naphtha trade dull as end-users stay out.

text.p: NWE naphtha trade continued dull with end-users mostly covered to the year-end and staying out of the market, traders said.
Spot prices largely ignored the bouncy fluctuations of crude futures and prices were little changed.

Trader buying interest persisted for specific quality (mainly pipeline spec), date and delivery point material at around $219-$220, but offers for heavier grades were reported as much as $8 below this.
However, traders said that despite a very narrow arbitrage window and some buying from the U.S. for gasoline, reforming grades were drawing little interest.
